intro.title: Bounty Hunting - Burning Springs Head Hunt Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Each Burning Springs Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and the gang they bring follows the same theme. This page lists every boss by group with their weapons, health, damage and resistances, plus the gang members and support wave that fight alongside them. All numbers update with every patch.
intro.profiles: Bosses are grouped the same way as the Head Hunt Groups lifetime challenges. Track your kills on the Grunt Hunt and Head Hunt Challenges page.
intro.mutations: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.
intro.mechanics: Burning Springs Head Hunt bosses share the following stats.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss across the bounty level range. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's main weapon at the bottom and top of the bounty level range.
intro.support: Every Burning Springs Head Hunt also sends a support wave that fights alongside the boss and its gang.
intro.npcs: Each boss brings its own gang members, listed with the boss they belong to.

mechanics.title: Feeds on hunger
lines: ×2 damage to you when your hunger bar is down to 17% or less.

weapons.name: Floater Flamer Grenade or Molotov Cocktail

mechanics.title: Frenzy aura
lines: other NPCs near him (not players, not other bounty targets) go into a frenzy and attack anything.

mechanics.title: Toxic Blood aura
lines: his aura ("All Enemies Toxic Blood") hands out a perk that makes hits apply Radscorpion Poison: 8 poison damage a second for 5 seconds plus 6 radiation.

lines: ×1.5 damage to you if you carry 600+ rads or play as a ghoul.

list.name: Chameleon
list.detail: Turns invisible while it stands still.

list.name: Freezing Touch
list.detail: Melee hits slow the target down.

list.name: Herd Mentality
list.detail: Weaker alone, stronger while grouped with its gang.

list.name: Plague Walker
list.detail: Emits a poison aura while it is sick.

list.name: Unstable Isotope
list.detail: Forced Unstable Isotope — can release a radiation burst when struck.

specialMechanicsNote: Each boss card lists the boss's special mechanics, plus any its side-kicks have. Ones marked Event switch only work while the Head Hunt effects switch is on, which it currently is.
